title: Shorter LR warmdown (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5->0.3)
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3, giving 70% of the 5-min budget at peak LR instead of 50%, keeping FINAL_LR_FRAC=0.0 and everything else at baseline (ASPECT_RATIO=96, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18, DEPTH=8).
reflection: val_bpb 0.985987 vs baseline 0.982558 -- a clear negative result (~0.35% worse), not noise (well outside the ~0.02% spread seen in duplicate runs this cell). The current 50% cooldown is apparently closer to optimal than a shorter one; the model likely needs the extended annealing phase to consolidate at this step count/width. I abandoned my original proposal (TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^17) at select time because a0 proposed the identical change, and picked this untested LR-schedule axis instead to avoid duplicating a slot. Next step on this axis: try lengthening warmdown further (e.g. 0.6-0.7) rather than shortening it, since shortening clearly hurt -- or leave WARMDOWN_RATIO alone and prioritize the weight-decay/matrix-lr axes other agents this round are covering, which look more promising.
